info.title: Conclave record API
info.description: Public, read-only. Everything here is derived from public on-chain receipts. No secret, no rollup token and no strategy code is ever served or accepted.

get.summary: The counting policy's output: the ranking, every excluded season with its reasons, and the exact rules in force.
Every season in the verified record, with its raw facts.
One season: raw facts, entries, the validator as a trust input, and flags.
A strategy by its permanent id: full history, the owner at each entry, whether it is closed, and flags.
Results by the owner recorded on each receipt.
Results grouped by code commitment (same salt and bytecode only).
Receipts of earlier builds, labelled as not verified history.
Freshness, last build, alarms and archive digests.
The four proof levels, what each establishes and does not, and where each runs.

post.summary: Level 1, stateless: the receipt lists this strategy (and commitment).
Level 3, stateless: the score commitment binds these totals, given the season's score salt.
Level 2, step 1: a single-use, expiring challenge to sign with the entering wallet.
Level 2, step 2: the signature over that challenge.
Level 4 is never accepted here: it runs in the browser or CLI, and the server never receives a salt or code.
